title: 软件、芯片与白银领涨，夜盘动能降温；中国人寿与B站业绩提供本地支点 + 美股盘前：Warsh讲话前期指横盘，ESTC与AFRM强势，MRVL/RBRK负反馈示警
summary: Moomoo完整扫描145个美股行业，应用软件、健康信息服务、半导体、焦炭和白银领涨，纺织制造、奢侈品和消费链居末；黄金+0.82%、白银+3.83%。Sparks网络安全、IDC与CPU走强，但负收益区未可靠加载并明确用5个ETF压力样本补足。08:24 CST夜盘QQQ、SPY、DIA代理分别-0.120%、-0.070%、+0.005%，NVDA与SMH转跌；中国人寿、B站和海尔业绩分化。 Warsh在Jackson Hole讲话前，SPY、QQQ、DIA盘前代理约+0.13%、-0.09%、+0.20%，10年期美债收益率约4.694%。ESTC与AFRM财报后分别约涨21.8%和12.8%，MRVL、RBRK、ADSK与S则因高预期或指引不足下跌；今晚无可验证的重要科技财报样本。

entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
国际
伊朗为霍尔木兹重新开放列出条件，航运走廊仍待落实
Reuters 8月27日报道，伊朗称已与阿曼就海峡航运走廊达成框架，但要求美国解除封锁、赔偿并取消制裁；停火安排此前两度未能维持。事实是通航谈判存在，判断是油价风险溢价仍难完全退出，执行条件具有高度不确定性。
国际
地区斡旋寻求停火出口，油轮遇袭与加沙冲突维持尾部风险
AP 8月27日报道，卡塔尔等地区力量继续寻求结束伊朗战争，同时霍尔木兹附近再报油轮袭击，以色列对加沙和黎巴嫩的行动仍在持续。能源、航运和避险资产可能继续对突发消息敏感。
科技
行业榜软件、半导体与白银领涨，消费链居末
Moomoo完整145行业榜显示应用软件+5.23%（CRM +22.58%）、健康信息服务+5.04%、半导体+4.43%（NVDA +8.74%）、焦炭+4.03%、白银+3.83%；纺织制造-12.18%、奢侈品-4.47%、杂货店-2.97%居末。A/H映射偏向软件、算力、芯片和贵金属，消费与出口链需防弱势扩散。
科技
Sparks网络安全、IDC与CPU走强，可靠负榜以压力样本补足
Sparks正数Top5为SOL储备+13.28%、网络安全+7.98%（OKTA +28.63%）、IDC +6.94%、CPU +6.83%、加密储备+6.49%；光通信另涨2.97%、AI PC涨3.02%。负收益区未可靠加载，面板仅以KWEB、XLY、JETS、XHB、XRT样本补足并明确披露，不能据此推断完整概念广度。
科技
芯片现金时段强势，但夜盘NVDA与SMH转跌
隔夜半导体行业+4.43%，NVDA现金时段+8.74%；08:24 CST夜盘NVDA -0.758%、SMH代理-0.729%，形成潜在反转。A/H芯片、光模块、服务器与PCB若高开但前30分钟不能放量守住，应优先控制追高风险。
科技
应用软件与网络安全大涨，夜盘动能开始收敛
应用软件行业+5.23%，CRM +22.58%；Sparks网络安全+7.98%，OKTA +28.63%。夜盘CRM仅+0.119%、OKTA -0.242%，由强确认转为背离/潜在反转；A/H软件、云服务和网络安全需以开盘相对恒生科技与创业板的强度验证。
财报
中国人寿利润与新业务价值高增，保险板块获本地支点
公司8月27日披露上半年总保费5366.34亿元、归母净利润1344.89亿元，同比+228.6%，新业务价值381.67亿元、同比+33.7%；Futu日历营收5366.34亿元高于约5308.12亿元预测。H股此前收29.32港元、+0.41%，正式开盘价格反馈仍待确认。
财报
哔哩哔哩盈利继续改善，美股价格先行确认
B站二季度营收79.4亿元、同比+8%，净利润3.39亿元，经调整净利润7亿元、同比+25%；上半年净利润5.41亿元、同比+160.6%。BILI现金时段+3.81%，夜盘-0.029%近持平；09626.HK需验证能否放量突破前收。
财报
海尔智家收入与利润同比下滑，汇率拖累需重新定价
海尔智家上半年营收1521.15亿元、同比-2.8%，归母净利润103.16亿元、同比-14.27%，扣非净利润同比-20.54%；Futu日历收入与EPS字段高于其一致预期，但同比趋势偏弱。H股此前收21.42港元、-0.46%，财报后开盘若继续弱于家电板块则不宜抢反弹。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘
夜盘指数
Futu OpenD运行时夜盘代理快照：QQQ -0.120%、SPY -0.070%、DIA +0.005%；行情为2026-08-27美东夜盘实时字段，抓取时间2026-08-28 08:24 CST。三者均为ETF代理，不表述为指数期货。
对照
板块对照
行业逐项：应用软件/CRM +0.119%确认；健康信息/ZCMD -3.103%、半导体/NVDA -0.758%为潜在反转；焦炭/METC、白银/AYA及广播/BBGI、赌场/BALY、杂货/VHUB、奢侈/BRLT、纺织/AIN均夜盘不可得。概念逐项：SOL/HSDT 0.000%为背离；网络安全/OKTA -0.242%、IDC与CPU共用NVDA -0.758%、加密储备/PPCB -16.591%均为潜在反转；压力样本KWEB +0.191%为潜在反转，XLY、JETS、XHB、XRT不可得。重复NVDA只抓取一次复用。
映射
A/H 映射
隔夜软件、芯片和白银强势对A/H仍是正向底稿，但QQQ、NVDA、SMH、GLD与SLV夜盘均转弱，短线采用“现金强、夜盘降温”的谨慎信号。开盘验证为恒生科技/创业板能否守住前收、芯片和软件成交是否放大、贵金属是否强于大盘；若高开后30分钟失守前收则映射失效。

盘前结论

事实：Moomoo完整行业榜显示应用软件、半导体与白银显著领涨，Sparks网络安全、IDC与CPU同步强势；中国人寿和B站披露了可验证的本地业绩改善。但消费链行业广度偏弱，Sparks负收益区只能以压力样本降级补足。

判断：A/H基准情景是软件、国产算力、芯片与贵金属先获映射，保险和B站获得财报支点。QQQ、NVDA、SMH、GLD与SLV夜盘反向，短线优先采用夜盘降温信号，不追隔夜涨幅。

不确定性：霍尔木兹谈判与冲突并存，完整Sparks负榜缺失；只有恒生科技/创业板守住前收且科技成交放大，或贵金属相对大盘继续走强，才把观察升级为顺势交易。

利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。

重点个股推荐

中国人寿
02628
业绩支点

推荐理由：上半年归母净利润同比+228.6%、新业务价值+33.7%，营收高于Futu日历预测，保险板块获得明确本地催化。

触发因素：开盘放量站上29.32港元前收并强于恒指金融板块。

风险点：利润受投资收益推动，权益市场和利率回撤会削弱持续性；未确认价格前不追高。

哔哩哔哩-W
09626
盈利改善

推荐理由：二季度营收同比+8%、经调整净利润同比+25%，BILI现金时段上涨3.81%，形成可验证正反馈。

触发因素：港股开盘守住129.7港元前收并放量，且强于恒生科技。

风险点：营收增速已降至个位数，夜盘近持平；若高开低走则降级为观察。

中芯国际
00981
芯片映射

推荐理由：美股半导体行业+4.43%、NVDA +8.74%，A/H先进制程与国产算力有直接映射。

触发因素：开盘强于恒生科技并放量，且前30分钟不跌回前收。

风险点：NVDA与SMH夜盘分别-0.758%和-0.729%，海外强势已出现潜在反转。

紫金矿业
02899
贵金属映射

推荐理由：Moomoo完整榜中白银+3.83%、其他贵金属+1.40%、黄金+0.82%，资源映射具有行业广度。

触发因素：金银矿股开盘相对恒指走强，且现货/ETF价格不继续回落。

风险点：GLD与SLV夜盘分别-0.307%和-0.430%，若贵金属低开则现金时段利好失效。

板块轮动看板

受益方向软件、网络安全、国产算力、半导体、白银与黄金；行业榜和Sparks现金时段共同支持，但夜盘降温要求量价确认。
观察方向保险、视频平台与消费电子；中国人寿、B站和海尔业绩分化，优先跟随正式开盘价格反馈。
压力方向纺织、奢侈品、杂货、零售及高估值科技追涨；行业负榜与夜盘反转共同限制风险偏好。
验证信号恒生科技/创业板守前收、芯片软件放量、贵金属强于大盘、02628与09626业绩后价格方向。

逻辑链

隔夜应用软件、半导体、白银与Sparks网络安全/IDC/CPU领涨，确认AI基础设施向软件和资源扩散。
海外强势映射A/H国产算力、芯片、云软件、贵金属，同时本地中国人寿与B站业绩提供独立支点。
运行时QQQ、NVDA、SMH、GLD与SLV转弱，说明现金涨幅进入兑现窗口，不能机械外推。
因此交易只在开盘守前收、相对指数走强且成交放大时成立；高开低走或贵金属继续回落即失效。

风险雷达

夜盘反转

QQQ、NVDA、SMH、GLD与SLV均转弱，海外现金时段强势可能在A/H开盘前降温。

Sparks负榜缺口

可靠负收益区未完整加载，补足样本只能提示压力，不能代表完整概念排序与广度。

霍尔木兹执行风险

航运走廊仍附带制裁、赔偿等条件，新袭击可迅速推升油价和避险需求。

财报价格背离

海尔同比下滑，中国人寿利润含投资收益弹性，B站增速放缓，headline与股价可能背离。

高开兑现

软件、芯片和网络安全隔夜涨幅较大，A/H若缩量高开，获利回吐风险高。

数据来源与时间点

来源：Moomoo美股行业榜（完整5页/145行业，重点复核黄金、其他贵金属、白银、铜、半导体）；Futunn Sparks首选页一次解析及Futu同BK成分现金快照；Futu OpenD HK/SH/SZ财报日历、四组NOTICE检索、股票快照与夜盘字段；Reuters、AP、中国人寿公告、哔哩哔哩业绩、海尔智家半年报。行业/概念现金行情为2026-08-27美东收盘；夜盘行情时间为2026-08-27美东夜盘，抓取时间2026-08-28 08:24 CST；页面更新时间2026-08-28 08:26 CST。Sparks可靠负收益区未加载，已明确使用5个ETF压力样本；ETF均为代理。
entries.html_en:
Major News Summary
Global
Iran sets terms for reopening Hormuz while the shipping corridor remains conditional
Reuters reported on Aug. 27 that Iran and Oman had a framework for a Strait shipping corridor, but Tehran demanded that the US lift its blockade, pay compensation and remove sanctions; two prior ceasefire arrangements failed. Negotiations are factual, but execution remains highly uncertain and the oil risk premium may persist.
Global
Regional mediation seeks an off-ramp as tanker attacks and Gaza fighting sustain tail risk
AP reported on Aug. 27 that Qatar and other regional powers kept seeking an end to the Iran war while another tanker attack was reported near Hormuz and Israeli operations in Gaza and Lebanon continued. Energy, shipping and havens remain sensitive to sudden headlines.
Tech
Software, semiconductors and silver led the industry table while consumer groups lagged
Moomoo's complete 145-industry table showed application software +5.23% (CRM +22.58%), health information services +5.04%, semiconductors +4.43% (NVDA +8.74%), coking coal +4.03% and silver +3.83%. Textile manufacturing -12.18%, luxury goods -4.47% and grocery stores -2.97% were the weakest. A/H mappings favor software, compute, chips and precious metals, while consumer and export chains face spillover risk.
Tech
Sparks cybersecurity, data centers and CPUs strengthened; verified pressure samples fill the unreliable negative range
Sparks' positive Top5 were SOL reserve +13.28%, cybersecurity +7.98% (OKTA +28.63%), data center +6.94%, CPU +6.83% and crypto treasury +6.49%; optical communication rose 2.97% and AI PC 3.02%. The negative range did not load reliably, so only disclosed KWEB, XLY, JETS, XHB and XRT samples fill the panel and do not represent complete concept breadth.
Tech
Chip strength in cash trading faded as NVDA and SMH turned lower overnight
The semiconductor industry gained 4.43% and NVDA rose 8.74% in cash trading; at 08:24 CST, NVDA was -0.758% and the SMH proxy -0.729% overnight, a potential reversal. If A/H chips, optical modules, servers and PCBs gap up but cannot hold on rising volume in the first 30 minutes, chasing risk takes priority.
Tech
Application software and cybersecurity surged, but overnight momentum narrowed
Application software gained 5.23% with CRM +22.58%; Sparks cybersecurity rose 7.98% with OKTA +28.63%. Overnight CRM was only +0.119% and OKTA -0.242%, shifting from strong confirmation toward divergence or potential reversal. A/H software, cloud and security need opening relative strength versus HSTECH and ChiNext.
Earnings
China Life's profit and new-business value surged, adding a local insurance anchor
China Life reported first-half gross written premiums of RMB536.63bn, attributable profit of RMB134.49bn, up 228.6%, and new-business value of RMB38.17bn, up 33.7%. Futu's calendar showed revenue above the roughly RMB530.81bn estimate. The H share previously closed at HKD29.32, +0.41%; post-results opening feedback is still pending.
Earnings
Bilibili extended its profit improvement and the US listing confirmed the result
Bilibili posted Q2 revenue of RMB7.94bn, up 8%, net income of RMB339m and adjusted net income of RMB700m, up 25%; first-half net income rose 160.6% to RMB541m. BILI gained 3.81% in cash trading and was nearly flat overnight at -0.029%; 09626.HK must confirm by breaking above its prior close on volume.
Earnings
Haier Smart Home's revenue and profit declined as FX drag requires repricing
Haier Smart Home reported first-half revenue of RMB152.12bn, down 2.8%, attributable profit of RMB10.32bn, down 14.27%, and adjusted profit down 20.54%. Futu calendar revenue and EPS fields exceeded its consensus, but the year-on-year trend was weak. The H share previously closed at HKD21.42, -0.46%; continued underperformance versus appliances would argue against bottom-fishing.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight
Overnight Indexes
Futu OpenD runtime overnight proxy snapshot: QQQ -0.120%, SPY -0.070% and DIA +0.005%. The fields were live for the Aug. 27 New York overnight session and captured at 08:24 CST on Aug. 28. All three are ETF proxies, not index futures.
Cross-check
Panel Cross-check
Industry rows: application software/CRM +0.119% confirmed; health information/ZCMD -3.103% and semiconductors/NVDA -0.758% were potential reversals; overnight data were unavailable for coking coal/METC, silver/AYA, broadcasting/BBGI, casinos/BALY, groceries/VHUB, luxury/BRLT and textiles/AIN. Concept rows: SOL/HSDT 0.000% diverged; cybersecurity/OKTA -0.242%, data center and CPU sharing NVDA -0.758%, and crypto treasury/PPCB -16.591% were potential reversals; pressure sample KWEB +0.191% was a potential reversal, while XLY, JETS, XHB and XRT were unavailable. The duplicate NVDA quote was fetched once and reused.
Mapping
A/H Mapping
Cash-session strength in software, chips and silver remains a positive base for A/H, but QQQ, NVDA, SMH, GLD and SLV all turned lower overnight, so the short-term signal is cautiously 'strong cash, cooling overnight.' Validate whether HSTECH and ChiNext hold prior closes, chip and software turnover expands, and precious metals outperform; a loss of prior close within 30 minutes after a gap-up invalidates the mapping.

Pre-open Conclusion

Fact: Moomoo's complete industry table showed application software, semiconductors and silver leading, while Sparks cybersecurity, data centers and CPUs strengthened; China Life and Bilibili delivered verifiable local earnings improvement.Consumer-industry breadth was weak, while Sparks negatives required disclosed pressure-sample supplementation.

View: the A/H base case gives the first mapping to software, domestic compute, chips and precious metals, with earnings anchors in insurance and Bilibili.QQQ, NVDA, SMH, GLD and SLV reversed overnight, so cooling overnight momentum takes precedence over chasing cash-session gains.

Uncertainty: Hormuz talks coexist with conflict and the complete Sparks negative range is missing. Upgrade observation only if HSTECH/ChiNext hold prior closes with expanding tech turnover or precious metals keep outperforming.

Risk: GLD and SLV fell 0.307% and 0.430% overnight; a weak open invalidates the cash-session tailwind.

Sector Rotation Board

BeneficiariesSoftware, cybersecurity, domestic compute, semiconductors, silver and gold; cash-session industry and Sparks signals agree, but overnight cooling requires price-volume confirmation.
WatchInsurance, video platforms and consumer electronics; China Life, Bilibili and Haier results diverged, so follow actual opening price feedback.
PressureTextiles, luxury, groceries, retail and chasing expensive tech; industry laggards and overnight reversals jointly limit risk appetite.
ValidationHSTECH/ChiNext holding prior closes, chip and software volume expansion, metals outperforming, and post-results direction in 02628 and 09626.

Logic Chain

Application software, semiconductors and silver led alongside Sparks cybersecurity, data centers and CPUs, confirming AI infrastructure spillover into software and resources.
That strength maps to A/H domestic compute, chips, cloud software and precious metals, while China Life and Bilibili earnings provide independent local anchors.
Runtime QQQ, NVDA, SMH, GLD and SLV turned lower, showing that cash-session gains entered a realization window and cannot be extrapolated mechanically.
A trade therefore requires holding prior close, relative outperformance and expanding turnover; a gap-and-fade or further metals weakness invalidates it.

Risk Radar

Overnight reversal

QQQ, NVDA, SMH, GLD and SLV all weakened, so US cash-session strength may cool before the A/H open.

Sparks negative gap

The reliable negative range did not fully load; supplemental samples signal pressure but cannot represent complete concept order or breadth.

Hormuz execution risk

The shipping corridor remains conditional on sanctions and compensation, while another attack could quickly lift oil and haven demand.

Earnings-price divergence

Haier declined year on year, China Life has investment-income sensitivity, and Bilibili growth slowed, so headlines can diverge from price.

Gap realization

Software, chips and cybersecurity posted large cash gains; a low-volume A/H gap-up carries high profit-taking risk.

entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
软件
Elastic beat并上调指引，盘前约涨21.8%
ESTC季度调整后EPS 0.70美元、营收4.781亿美元，均高于约0.58美元和4.697亿美元预期，并上调FY2027展望；强价格反馈确认搜索、可观测性与安全软件需求。
期指
美股期指横盘，科技优势较昨日明显降温
约08:30 ET，SPY、QQQ、DIA与IWM盘前代理分别约+0.13%、-0.09%、+0.20%和-0.02%。指数分化显示昨日AI财报热度尚未转化为全面追涨。
金融科技
Affirm财报后盘前约涨12.8%
AFRM录得创纪录盈利与强劲业务增长，盘前约87.43美元、涨12.8%。收入口径在公开报道间存在差异，因此本稿以公司披露与价格反馈为主，不夸大单项数字。
芯片
Marvell beat后盘前反跌约7.6%
MRVL二季度EPS 0.94美元、营收27.4亿美元，高于约0.93美元和27.1亿美元预期，但Google定制芯片协议的收入兑现更偏后期；高估值与高预期触发明显负反馈，禁止作为多头推荐。
安全
Rubrik强业绩仍遭卖出，盘前约跌7.5%
RBRK营收4.273亿美元、同比增38%，调整后EPS 0.20美元并上调全年展望，但此前涨幅与同业强财报抬高门槛；盘前约跌7.5%，只能作为等待止跌的风险观察。
宏观
Warsh讲话成为开盘后的首要波动源
美联储主席Kevin Warsh定于10:00 ET在Jackson Hole发表讲话；市场将从通胀、长期利率与政策沟通中寻找方向。讲话与密歇根大学终值数据均在开盘后，盘前仓位不宜把政策路径视为已确定。
资产
长债收益率上行，油金回落
10年期美债收益率约4.694%、较前值高约2.2个基点；布伦特约87.85美元、跌0.76%，黄金期货约4654美元、跌0.21%。利率压力限制长久期估值，油价回落则提供部分通胀缓冲。
国际
霍尔木兹通航改善与伊朗战争仍并存
美国称海峡主航道扫雷取得进展，伊朗与阿曼讨论更安全的商业通行框架；但战争持续且航运风险未消失。油价风险溢价回落可以交易，不能视为地缘风险终结。
隔夜
NVDA与CRM大涨，但标普成分股多数下跌
周四NVDA与CRM分别上涨8.7%和22.6%，推动纳指上涨1.6%、标普500上涨0.7%；但标普500多数成分股下跌，说明上涨集中度仍高。
指引
Autodesk与SentinelOne被前瞻指引拖累
ADSK季度业绩超过预期，但全年调整后EPS指引中值低于共识，盘前约跌4.5%；S因季度与全年利润指引低于预期盘前约跌4.6%。headline beat不等于可追多。

盘前结论

事实：ESTC与AFRM盘前分别约涨21.8%和12.8%，而SPY、QQQ、DIA仅约+0.13%、-0.09%、+0.20%。个股财报驱动强于指数，广度仍不充分。

判断：基准情景是软件与金融科技中的正反馈标的相对强势，指数在Warsh讲话前后双向震荡。MRVL、RBRK、ADSK和S的下跌说明市场正在惩罚兑现偏慢或指引不足。

不确定性：10:00 ET的Warsh讲话与消费者信心终值可重定价收益率；若QQQ转弱、10年期突破早盘水平或强势股缺口快速收窄，应降低追涨仓位。

利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。

重点个股推荐

Elastic
ESTC
财报领涨

推荐理由：财报beat并上调全年展望，盘前约涨21.8%，显著强于QQQ与软件大盘；公开盘前可比成交量口径不完整。

触发因素：开盘后守住大部分缺口、相对软件指数继续走强且成交扩张。

风险点：大幅跳空与高估值易引发获利回吐；若前30分钟回补超过一半缺口，停止追多。

Affirm
AFRM
盈利正反馈

推荐理由：创纪录盈利与强业务增长获得约12.8%的盘前正反馈，明显强于大盘；公开盘前可比成交量口径不完整。

触发因素：开盘守住85美元附近的盘前承接，并继续强于金融科技同业。

风险点：消费信用、资金成本与收入披露口径差异；若跌回昨收附近，降级为观察。

Take-Two Interactive
TTWO
事件驱动

推荐理由：GTA VI扩展内容发布后盘前约涨2.6%，在QQQ微跌时保持相对强势；公开盘前可比成交量口径不完整。

触发因素：开盘维持强于QQQ且成交放大，市场继续上修产品发布热度。

风险点：内容事件交易持续性较短，发行节奏或预期落空会迅速压缩溢价。

NVIDIA
NVDA
强势承接

推荐理由：周四财报后上涨8.7%，周五盘前约跌0.08%，与QQQ约-0.09%相当，未出现明显负反馈；公开盘前可比成交量口径不完整。

触发因素：开盘守住周四大涨后的支撑，并重新强于QQQ与半导体指数。

风险点：昨日涨幅已大、Warsh讲话和获利回吐风险高；弱于板块时只观察、不追价。

板块轮动看板

强势观察企业软件与金融科技：ESTC、AFRM；仅跟随开盘后仍强于QQQ且成交扩张者。
事件驱动TTWO内容发布、10:00 ET Warsh讲话及消费者信心终值；政策与利率将决定日内风格。
压力方向MRVL、RBRK、ADSK、S：均有看似利好或beat却遭盘前下跌，等待止跌确认并回避追多。
验证信号QQQ能否由负转正；10年期是否突破4.70%；ESTC/AFRM缺口保持度；MRVL/RBRK是否继续放量下探。

逻辑链

周四NVDA与CRM强财报推动纳指上涨1.6%，但标普多数成分股下跌，先确认行情集中而非全面扩张。
周五ESTC与AFRM继续获得强价格反馈，说明资金仍愿意奖励可验证的盈利和上调指引。
MRVL、RBRK、ADSK与S的盘前下跌同时证明，headline beat无法抵消高预期、兑现时点和利润指引不足。
因此开盘策略是跟随强反馈而非行业故事；Warsh讲话、10年期收益率与缺口保持度决定是否扩大风险敞口。

盘后财报 beat 概率

已核对Kiplinger/Briefing.com、Nasdaq/Yahoo Finance公开日历、TipRanks与公司IR；8月28日周五盘后无可验证的重要科技公司财报样本，因此不虚构概率。以下为时间核验，不是对已披露业绩的预测。

高概率 · 无可验证样本日历未列出8月28日盘后值得覆盖的科技公司，无法基于一致预期、历史surprise、近期指引、卖方修正和行业景气形成合规高概率判断。
中概率 · 无可验证样本没有确认的盘后科技公司及一致预期组合；信息不足时不给出伪精确百分比。
低概率 · 无可验证样本零星小公司日历的披露时点与预期覆盖不足，未达到可验证门槛。
已披露 · MRVL、ADSK、WDAYMarvell Technology (MRVL)、Autodesk (ADSK)与Workday (WDAY)均已于8月27日盘后披露，不属于今晚待公布样本。
已披露 · RBRK、S、ESTC、AFRMRubrik (RBRK)、SentinelOne (S)、Elastic (ESTC)与Affirm (AFRM)均已于8月27日盘后披露；本稿只分析其盘前价格反馈。

风险雷达

Warsh政策意外

若讲话强化更长期高利率或通胀优先，美元与收益率可能上行并压制科技估值。

财报缺口回补

ESTC与AFRM跳空较大，若开盘快速回补一半以上缺口，正反馈交易失效。

负反馈扩散

MRVL、RBRK、ADSK与S若继续下探，可能从个股指引问题扩散为科技风险偏好收缩。

霍尔木兹再扰动

通航改善尚未结束伊朗战争，油轮安全事件可让油价与通胀预期反弹。

盘前量能缺口

公开源未提供全部候选股统一可比的盘前成交量，所有推荐均要求开盘量价确认。

数据来源与时间点

来源：AP、Reuters/AOL、Axios（全球市场、Iran/霍尔木兹、Warsh）；Investing.com（期指、收益率、油金、盘前个股）；Benzinga（ESTC、AFRM、MRVL、RBRK盘前快照）；公司业绩稿与公开财报摘要；Kiplinger/Briefing.com、Nasdaq/Yahoo Finance、TipRanks与公司IR财报日历。抓取/更新时间：2026-08-28 20:36 CST（约08:36 ET）。公开盘前统一成交量与卖方修正细项不完整，已降级并要求开盘确认。
entries.html_en:
Major News Roundup
Software
Elastic beats and raises; shares jump about 21.8% premarket
ESTC posted adjusted EPS of $0.70 and revenue of $478.1 million, above expectations near $0.58 and $469.7 million, and raised its FY2027 outlook. Strong price feedback validates demand in search, observability and security software.
Futures
US futures are flat as yesterday's tech edge cools
Around 08:30 ET, SPY, QQQ, DIA and IWM premarket proxies were about +0.13%, -0.09%, +0.20% and -0.02%. The split tape shows that yesterday's AI earnings enthusiasm has not become a broad chase.
Fintech
Affirm gains about 12.8% after earnings
AFRM delivered record profitability and strong business growth, trading near $87.43 and up 12.8% premarket. Public reports differ on certain revenue presentations, so this brief emphasizes the company disclosure and price response without overstating a single figure.
Chips
Marvell reverses about 7.6% lower despite a beat
MRVL posted Q2 EPS of $0.94 and revenue of $2.74 billion, above roughly $0.93 and $2.71 billion expected, but revenue from the Google custom-chip agreement is weighted further out. High valuation and expectations produced clear negative feedback, disqualifying it from a bullish pick.
Security
Rubrik sells off despite strong results, down about 7.5%
RBRK revenue reached $427.3 million, up 38%, adjusted EPS was $0.20 and the company raised its full-year outlook. A prior run-up and strong peer reports had lifted the bar; the 7.5% premarket drop makes this a wait-for-stabilization risk watch only.
Macro
Warsh's speech is the primary post-open volatility catalyst
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is due to speak at Jackson Hole at 10:00 ET. Markets will look for direction on inflation, long-term yields and policy communication. The speech and final Michigan data arrive after the open, so the policy path is not settled premarket.
Assets
Long yields rise while oil and gold ease
The 10-year Treasury yield was near 4.694%, about 2.2 basis points higher; Brent was near $87.85, down 0.76%, and gold futures near $4,654, down 0.21%. Higher yields constrain long-duration valuations, while lower oil offers a partial inflation cushion.
Global
Improved Hormuz passage coexists with the Iran war
The US says mine-clearing has progressed in the main channel, while Iran and Oman discuss a safer commercial-passage framework. The war and shipping risks persist. A lower oil risk premium is tradable, but it does not mean geopolitical risk has ended.
Overnight
NVDA and CRM surged, but most S&P 500 members fell
NVDA and CRM rose 8.7% and 22.6% Thursday, helping the Nasdaq gain 1.6% and the S&P 500 gain 0.7%. Yet most S&P 500 members declined, showing that market leadership remains concentrated.
Guidance
Forward guidance weighs on Autodesk and SentinelOne
ADSK beat quarterly expectations but its full-year adjusted EPS midpoint trailed consensus, sending shares down about 4.5% premarket. S fell about 4.6% as quarterly and full-year profit guidance missed expectations. A headline beat is not a reason to chase.

Premarket Conclusion

Fact: ESTC and AFRM were up about 21.8% and 12.8% premarket, while SPY, QQQ and DIA were only about +0.13%, -0.09% and +0.20%.Single-stock earnings are stronger than the index tape, and breadth is incomplete.

View: the base case favors relative strength in software and fintech names with positive feedback, while indexes swing around Warsh's speech.Declines in MRVL, RBRK, ADSK and S show that markets are punishing delayed monetization or weak guidance.

Uncertainty: Warsh and final consumer sentiment at 10:00 ET can reprice yields. Reduce chase exposure if QQQ weakens, the 10-year breaks above its morning level, or strong gaps fade quickly.

BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 denotes heat/importance, not percentage change.

Stocks to Watch

Elastic
ESTC
Earnings leader

Why: an earnings beat and higher full-year outlook produced a roughly 21.8% premarket gain, far stronger than QQQ and the broader software tape. Comparable public premarket volume is incomplete.

Trigger: hold most of the gap after the open, retain relative strength versus software and expand volume.

Risk: a large gap and elevated valuation invite profit-taking; stop chasing if more than half the gap is filled in the first 30 minutes.

Affirm
AFRM
Profit feedback

Why: record profitability and strong business growth earned a roughly 12.8% positive premarket response, far ahead of the market. Comparable public premarket volume is incomplete.

Trigger: hold support near the premarket $85 area and stay stronger than fintech peers.

Risk: consumer credit, funding costs and differences among reported revenue presentations; downgrade to watch if it returns near Thursday's close.

Take-Two Interactive
TTWO
Event-driven

Why: shares rose about 2.6% premarket after expanded GTA VI content, showing relative strength while QQQ slipped. Comparable public premarket volume is incomplete.

Trigger: remain stronger than QQQ after the open with expanding volume as the market sustains launch enthusiasm.

Risk: content-event trades can fade quickly, while release timing or unmet expectations can erase the premium.

NVIDIA
NVDA
Strong hold

Why: after gaining 8.7% Thursday on earnings, NVDA was down only about 0.08% Friday premarket, roughly matching QQQ's -0.09% without clear negative feedback. Comparable public premarket volume is incomplete.

Trigger: defend post-rally support after the open and regain relative strength versus QQQ and semiconductors.

Risk: Thursday's move was already large, with Warsh and profit-taking ahead; watch rather than chase when it lags the sector.

Sector Rotation Board

Strength watchEnterprise software and fintech: ESTC and AFRM. Follow only names that stay stronger than QQQ with expanding volume after the open.
Event-drivenTTWO content news, Warsh at 10:00 ET and final consumer sentiment. Policy and yields will determine the intraday style.
PressureMRVL, RBRK, ADSK and S: each had superficially positive news or a beat but fell premarket. Wait for stabilization and avoid chasing longs.
ValidationCan QQQ turn positive? Does the 10-year break 4.70%? Do ESTC/AFRM hold gaps? Do MRVL/RBRK extend lower on volume?

Logic Chain

Strong NVDA and CRM reports lifted the Nasdaq 1.6% Thursday, but most S&P 500 members fell, confirming concentration rather than broad expansion.
ESTC and AFRM keep receiving strong price feedback Friday, showing that investors still reward verified profit and raised guidance.
Premarket declines in MRVL, RBRK, ADSK and S show that headline beats cannot offset high expectations, monetization timing or weak profit guidance.
The opening strategy is therefore to follow price-confirmed strength, not sector stories; Warsh, the 10-year yield and gap retention decide whether to add risk.

After-hours Earnings Beat Probabilities

Kiplinger/Briefing.com, public Nasdaq/Yahoo Finance calendars, TipRanks and company IR were checked. No verifiable noteworthy technology report is scheduled after the close on Friday, August 28, so no probabilities are fabricated. The timing audit below is not a forecast of already reported results.

High probability · No verifiable sampleCalendars list no technology company worth covering after the August 28 close, so a compliant high-probability judgment cannot be formed from consensus, historical surprises, recent guidance, sell-side revisions and industry conditions.
Medium probability · No verifiable sampleThere is no confirmed after-hours technology company paired with reliable consensus expectations; insufficient information does not justify a false-precision percentage.
Low probability · No verifiable sampleTiming and estimate coverage for scattered small-company listings do not meet the verification threshold.
Already reported · MRVL, ADSK, WDAYMarvell Technology (MRVL), Autodesk (ADSK) and Workday (WDAY) all reported after the August 27 close and are not pending tonight.
Already reported · RBRK, S, ESTC, AFRMRubrik (RBRK), SentinelOne (S), Elastic (ESTC) and Affirm (AFRM) also reported after the August 27 close; this brief analyzes only their premarket price feedback.

Risk Radar

Warsh policy surprise

A stronger higher-for-longer or inflation-first message could lift the dollar and yields and compress tech valuations.

Earnings-gap reversal

ESTC and AFRM have large gaps; filling more than half shortly after the open would invalidate the positive-feedback trade.

Negative feedback spreads

Further weakness in MRVL, RBRK, ADSK and S could broaden from company guidance issues into lower technology risk appetite.

Renewed Hormuz disruption

Improved passage has not ended the Iran war; a tanker-security event could lift oil and inflation expectations again.

Premarket volume gap

Public sources lack uniform comparable premarket volume for every candidate, so all picks require post-open price-volume confirmation.
